hooks.text: 单人或四人合作率领苏格兰军团，在45个手工战场中收复岛屿
hooks.excerpt: Reconquer your island with your friends or by yourself through over 45 handcrafted environments with endless opportunities for unique scenarios and objectives.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 战役升级可与百余件神器叠加，让多名英雄形成不同爆发构筑
hooks.excerpt: Obtain powerful upgrades and combine them with over a hundred artifacts to create distinctive and devastating builds. Choose from multiple unique playable heroes and unleash increasingly explosive and lethal attacks directly from the frontlines.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 军团士兵会跨战役获得永久技能，可持续招募、升级并并肩作战
hooks.excerpt: Your soldiers gain permanent skills between campaigns. Recruit, upgrade and fight alongside them as they become essential assets in your upcoming battles.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
